findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 3 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 25 questions numbered 1-25; by section: 3.1 1, 3.13 1, 3.1.4 2, 3.2 1, u-dipole-moment-and-polarity-of-molecules 1, 3.3.2 4, 3.3.3 1, 3.4.1 2, 3.5.1 2, 3.6 1, 3.6.1 3, 3.7 1, 3.9 4, 3.10 1.

Theory parts cover the Lewis concept and ionic bond, covalent and dative bonds, expanded octets, electronegativity and bond type, dipole moment, VSEPR postulates and the AB₃, AB₄, AB₅, AB₆ systems, VSEPR in drug design, VBT (sigma and pi bonds), sp³, sp², sp hybridization, MOT postulates and p-orbital MOs, MO diagrams of He₂, N₂ and O₂, intermolecular forces, bond energy, bond length and the comparison of bonds. Numericals (electron counts, electronegativity differences, bond orders, bond energies, bond lengths) use new values recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: I₃⁻ linear with three lone pairs, F-Xe-F, σ (not δ), σ*2px, NO₃⁻; the C≡N value of Table 3.2 is not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
